"'''The Duke'''" was [[Davith Elso/Legends|Davith Elso's]] former mentor. The Duke was a trusted source for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], but was secretly selling information to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="Reclassified" />
